corresponding_source.policy: Tag every externally distributed build and archive this repository at that tag, including Package.swift, project.yml, Xcode project, tests, and Scripts/. Upstream submodules are reference-only and are not required to rebuild the Sugarman app binary.

records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: The pinned Android reference and an independently observed owned Mainland GS3 both use 12-character uppercase alphanumeric advertised names beginning with AA. Independently authored Swift uses this only as a presentation heuristic to rank a likely GS3 first in a read-only scan list. No upstream implementation was copied.

records.source_path: Owned Mainland GS3 read-only iOS GATT discovery
records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: A schema-v1 map records independently observed service and characteristic UUIDs, properties, and allowlisted Device Information byte counts from an owned active Mainland GS3. Identifiers, serial bytes, raw values, authentication material, and glucose data are omitted. Zephyr documentation is used only to identify the observed SMP UUIDs.
records.author: chris
records.fixtures_origin: Owned active Mainland GS3; Sugarman read-only iOS discovery after official Android app release
records.notes: Public fixture contains UUIDs, GATT properties, and byte counts only. Exact sensor name, CoreBluetooth identifier, device serials, account data, screenshots, glucose value, and raw Android HCI payloads remain private. No write, authentication, binding, activation, reset, or firmware-management request was sent.
